{{Otheruses|Descent}}
A '''descent cable''' was a type of [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] used during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="The Library of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Library of Nul|[[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]}}</ref> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> one was in the [[Charred Divide]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], used by [[Talos Drellik]]'s excavation team to reach [[Darth Nul's Laboratory]].<ref name="The Library of Nul" /> Another was at the ruins of [[Emperor's Fortress]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], used by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Farrus Belisk]]'s survey team to [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|descend]] to the fortress' lower levels, then later used by the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]].<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Dark Heart of the Fortress|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Descent cables first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
